subject: maths
prompt_en: Describe how you would mark angle XYZ on a drawing. Where does the little arc go, and which rays are the arms?
prompt_hi: Batao drawing pe angle XYZ kaise mark karoge. Chhota arc kahan jaayega, aur arms kaun si rays hain?
answer: The arc goes at Y, the vertex; the arms are rays YX and YZ

subject: maths
prompt_en: Asha named the angle with its vertex at B and arms going to A and C as 'angle BAC'. What is wrong?
prompt_hi: Asha ne us angle ka naam 'angle BAC' rakha jiska vertex B pe hai aur arms A aur C ki taraf hain. Kya galat hai?
answer: The vertex must be the middle letter: angle ABC or angle CBA

subject: maths
prompt_en: At a crossing, one auto-rickshaw turns right (a quarter turn) and another takes a U-turn. Which turned through a bigger angle, and how many times bigger?
prompt_hi: Ek chauraahe pe ek auto right mudta hai (quarter turn) aur doosra U-turn leta hai. Kisne bada angle ghooma, aur kitne guna bada?
answer: The U-turn, which is a half turn: 2 times as big

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach your little brother how to tell which of two angles is bigger.
prompt_hi: Apne chhote bhai ko sikhao ki do angles mein se bada kaunsa hai yeh kaise pata karein.
answer: Put the vertices together and lay one arm on the other; the angle whose second arm is turned further out is bigger; arm length does not matter

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! What do we call the two rays that make an angle?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! Angle banane wali do rays ko kya kehte hain?
answer: The arms

subject: maths
prompt_en: Two equal angles: I mark one with a tiny arc and the other with a big arc. Predict: does the big arc make it a bigger angle?
prompt_hi: Do barabar angles: ek pe chhota arc, doosre pe bada arc lagata hoon. Guess karo: kya bada arc angle ko bada bana deta hai?
answer: No; the arc only shows which angle we mean, the turn is the same

subject: maths
prompt_en: How many degrees are there in a quarter turn, a half turn and a full turn?
prompt_hi: Quarter turn, half turn aur full turn mein kitne degree hote hain?

subject: maths
prompt_en: An angle looks sharp and narrow. Where its arm crosses the protractor, the two scales show 40 and 140. Predict which is right before reading.
prompt_hi: Ek angle nukeela aur patla dikhta hai. Jahan uski arm protractor ko kaat rahi hai wahan 40 aur 140 likha hai. Padhne se pehle guess karo, sahi kaunsa hai.
answer: 40°, because a narrow angle is less than a right angle

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why does a protractor have two sets of numbers, and how do you choose which to read?
prompt_hi: Protractor pe numbers ke do set kyon hote hain, aur kaunsa padhna hai yeh kaise chunein?
answer: So you can measure from either arm, left or right; read the scale that starts at 0 on the arm lying along the baseline

subject: maths
prompt_en: I measured the slope of a park slide against the ground and wrote 150°, but the slide does not look steep. The scales read 30 and 150. What did I probably do?
prompt_hi: Maine park ki slide ka zameen ke saath angle naapa aur 150° likha, par slide zyada steep nahi lagti. Scales pe 30 aur 150 tha. Maine shayad kya kiya?
answer: Read the wrong scale; the angle is 30°

subject: maths
prompt_en: Say the steps to draw an angle of 70° at point A.
prompt_hi: Point A pe 70° ka angle banane ke steps batao.
answer: Draw an arm AB; put the protractor centre on A with the baseline on AB; mark 70 on the scale that starts at 0 on AB; join A to that mark

subject: maths
prompt_en: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 2 o'clock?
prompt_hi: 2 baje ghadi ki suiyon ke beech kitna angle hota hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: For the same opening, the two scales show 65 and 115. What do these two numbers always add up to, and why?
prompt_hi: Ek hi opening ke liye dono scales pe 65 aur 115 aata hai. Yeh dono numbers milkar hamesha kitna banate hain, aur kyon?
answer: 180, because the two scales run in opposite directions across a half turn

subject: maths
prompt_en: A ceiling fan has 3 equally spaced blades. What is the angle between two neighbouring blades?
prompt_hi: Ceiling fan ke 3 blades barabar doori pe hain. Do paas wale blades ke beech kitna angle hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Sameer put the bottom edge of his protractor at the vertex instead of the small centre mark. Will his reading be right?
prompt_hi: Sameer ne protractor ka neeche ka kinara vertex pe rakha, centre mark nahi. Kya uski reading sahi aayegi?
answer: No; the centre mark must sit exactly on the vertex or the reading will be off

subject: maths
prompt_en: You measure the same angle with a small protractor and then the big blackboard one. Predict the two readings.
prompt_hi: Ek hi angle ko chhote protractor aur blackboard wale bade protractor se naapo. Dono readings guess karo.
answer: They are the same

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend the three steps for measuring an angle with a protractor.
prompt_hi: Dost ko protractor se angle naapne ke 3 steps sikhao.
answer: Centre mark on the vertex; baseline along one arm; read where the other arm crosses, on the scale that starts at 0 on the first arm

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! How many degrees between the hands at 3 o'clock?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! 3 baje suiyon ke beech kitne degree?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Is an angle of 120° acute, right or obtuse?
prompt_hi: 120° ka angle acute, right ya obtuse?
answer: Obtuse

subject: maths
prompt_en: What type of angle is exactly 180°?
prompt_hi: Theek 180° ka angle kis type ka hota hai?
answer: A straight angle

subject: maths
prompt_en: Open a book flat on the table. Predict: is there an angle between the two covers?
prompt_hi: Kitaab ko table pe poori tarah khol do. Guess karo: kya dono covers ke beech angle hai?
answer: Yes, a straight angle of 180°

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why do we count a straight line through a point as an angle?
prompt_hi: Ek point se guzarti seedhi line ko hum angle kyon maante hain?
answer: It is two rays from the same vertex pointing opposite ways; turning from one to the other is half a full turn, 180°

subject: maths
prompt_en: One right angle has its arms flat and upright. The same right angle is drawn tilted. Is the tilted one still a right angle?
prompt_hi: Ek right angle ki arms seedhi khadi aur leti hui hain. Wahi right angle tirchha banaya hai. Kya tirchha wala abhi bhi right angle hai?
answer: Yes; turning on the page does not change its measure, it is still 90°

subject: maths
prompt_en: At 3 o'clock the hands make 90° on one side. What is the angle on the other side, and what type is it?
prompt_hi: 3 baje suiyan ek taraf 90° banati hain. Doosri taraf ka angle kitna hai, aur kis type ka?
answer: 270°, a reflex angle

subject: maths
prompt_en: I sorted: 89° is obtuse and 91° is acute. Fix me.
prompt_hi: Maine sort kiya: 89° obtuse aur 91° acute. Theek karo.
answer: They are swapped: 89° is acute and 91° is obtuse

subject: maths
prompt_en: At 4 o'clock, is the smaller angle between the hands acute, right or obtuse?
prompt_hi: 4 baje suiyon ke beech ka chhota angle acute, right ya obtuse hai?
answer: Obtuse (120°)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Two roads cross and make four angles. One of them is 70°. What are the other three, and their types?
prompt_hi: Do sadkein ek doosre ko kaatti hain aur chaar angles banati hain. Ek angle 70° hai. Baaki 3 kitne hain, aur kis type ke?
answer: 110° (obtuse), 70° (acute), 110° (obtuse)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Say the type of the smaller angle between the clock hands at 1 o'clock, 3 o'clock, 5 o'clock and 6 o'clock.
prompt_hi: 1 baje, 3 baje, 5 baje aur 6 baje suiyon ke beech ke chhote angle ka type batao.
answer: 1: acute (30°); 3: right (90°); 5: obtuse (150°); 6: straight (180°)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend the five types of angles, with an example of each from your home.
prompt_hi: Dost ko paanch type ke angles sikhao, har ek ka ghar se example dekar.
answer: Acute (< 90°, e.g. a slice of pizza tip), right (90°, a door frame corner), obtuse (between 90° and 180°, a reclining chair), straight (180°, an open book flat), reflex (> 180°, the outside of a slightly open laptop)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! What type of angle is the corner of a page?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! Page ke corner ka angle kis type ka hai?
answer: A right angle

subject: maths
prompt_en: Each child calls out how many of their neighbours (the children standing right next to them) are taller than them. Same line: 140, 152, 135, 148, 150. What does every child say, in order?
prompt_hi: Har bachcha bolta hai ki uske bilkul bagal wale bachchon mein se kitne usse lambe hain. Wahi line: 140, 152, 135, 148, 150. Har bachcha kya bolega, order mein?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Each child calls out how many of their neighbours (the children standing right next to them) are taller than them. Predict: can the child at the very end of the line ever say 2?
prompt_hi: Har bachcha bolta hai ki uske bilkul bagal wale bachchon mein se kitne usse lambe hain. Guess karo: kya line ke bilkul aakhri bachche ka number kabhi 2 ho sakta hai?
answer: No, the end child has only one neighbour

subject: maths
prompt_en: Each child calls out how many of their neighbours (the children standing right next to them) are taller than them. Why must the tallest child always say 0?
prompt_hi: Har bachcha bolta hai ki uske bilkul bagal wale bachchon mein se kitne usse lambe hain. Sabse lamba bachcha hamesha 0 hi kyon bolega?
answer: No neighbour can be taller than the tallest child

subject: maths
prompt_en: Row: 23, 48, 15, 62, 41. Which are supercells? (End cells have only one neighbour.)
prompt_hi: Row: 23, 48, 15, 62, 41. Kaun se supercells hain? (Kinare wale cells ka ek hi neighbour hota hai.)
answer: 48 and 62

subject: maths
prompt_en: I said only 62 is a supercell in 23, 48, 15, 62, 41, because it is the biggest. Am I right?
prompt_hi: Maine kaha 23, 48, 15, 62, 41 mein sirf 62 supercell hai kyunki woh sabse bada hai. Kya main sahi hoon?
answer: No: 48 is also a supercell, because it only has to beat its own neighbours 23 and 15

subject: maths
prompt_en: Row: 7, 3, 9, 2, 8, 5. Which are supercells?
prompt_hi: Row: 7, 3, 9, 2, 8, 5. Kaun se supercells hain?
answer: 7, 9 and 8

subject: maths
prompt_en: Ravi's row is 2, 9, 1, 7, 3. Sita's row is 8, 1, 4, 2, 6. Both say their row has 2 supercells. Who is right?
prompt_hi: Ravi ki row 2, 9, 1, 7, 3 hai. Sita ki row 8, 1, 4, 2, 6 hai. Dono kehte hain unki row mein 2 supercells hain. Kaun sahi hai?
answer: Ravi: his are 9 and 7. Sita has 3: 8, 4 and 6

subject: maths
prompt_en: Each child calls out how many of their neighbours (the children standing right next to them) are taller than them. Predict: can you line up 5 children of different heights so that EVERY child says 1?
prompt_hi: Har bachcha bolta hai ki uske bilkul bagal wale bachchon mein se kitne usse lambe hain. Guess karo: kya alag-alag height ke 5 bachchon ko aise line mein khada kar sakte ho ki HAR bachcha 1 bole?
answer: No: the tallest child always says 0

subject: maths
prompt_en: Each child calls out how many of their neighbours (the children standing right next to them) are taller than them. 6 cricket players of heights 1 to 6 (shortest to tallest) stand in a row for a photo. Can exactly 3 of them say 0? Give an order.
prompt_hi: Har bachcha bolta hai ki uske bilkul bagal wale bachchon mein se kitne usse lambe hain. Photo ke liye 1 se 6 height (chhote se lambe) ke 6 cricket players ek row mein khade hain. Kya theek 3 players 0 bol sakte hain? Ek order batao.

subject: maths
prompt_en: Explain to a friend how a puzzle can have more than one answer, or no answer, and why both still count as solving it.
prompt_hi: Dost ko samjhao ki ek puzzle ke ek se zyada answer ya koi answer na hona kaise ho sakta hai, aur dono kyon 'solve karna' maane jaate hain.
answer: Many arrangements can satisfy a rule (e.g. many rows with 2 supercells); if none can, a reason like 'the tallest always says 0' proves it, and that proof is the answer
